verdict_reason: The rename to Address and the move to ListCriteria are complete, but five list tests assert only stub-returned values, the fixture id is retyped 25 times beside its shared constant, and one create title claims a header the service never reads.

todos.issue: Five list tests assert only on values their own stub returned, so the visible assertion cannot fail: list_withOnlyBlankCountryCodesPassesNoCountryCodes (:408), list_passesTheSearchTermAsAPartialMatchPattern (:419), list_withABlankSearchTermPassesNoPattern (:442), list_passesTheSearchPatternAndTrimmedCountryCodesTogether (:452) and list_passesTheSearchRolesAsOneSearchTerm (:491). Each one assertThat(response.totalItems()).isZero() against emptyFirstPage(). What the title claims, the ListCriteria passed to the repository, is proven only because MockitoExtension's strict stubs throw PotentialStubbingProblem when eq(expected) does not match. A reader cannot see that, and it stops working under lenient().
todos.fix: Must: each list test that claims what is passed to the repository asserts the ListCriteria it received in its own assertions. One way: capture the criteria with an ArgumentCaptor<ListCriteria> (as list_asksForNewestFirstAndTranslatesToA0BasedPage does for Pageable) and assertThat(captor.getValue()).isEqualTo(expected), dropping the totalItems isZero lines.

todos.issue: The test moved to the shared storedAddress fixture and imports STORED_CREATED_AT and STORED_MODIFIED_AT, but types the fixture's id "665f1c2ab3e4d51a2c9d0e77" by hand 25 times (:78, :90, :146, :149, :156, :159, :167, :170, :179, :184, :196, :204, :215, :220, :229, :234, :242, :247, :252, :257, :263, :268, :272, :278, :281). AddressTestSupport already names it STORED_ADDRESS_ID (:14), so the stubs' id only lines up with the fixture's id because two literals match.
todos.fix: Must: the stored address's id has one home, AddressTestSupport.STORED_ADDRESS_ID, and every stub argument and assertion in AddressServiceTest that means that address uses it. One way: static-import STORED_ADDRESS_ID and replace the literals.

todos.issue: create_stampsOrganisationIdAndActiveStatusFromTheHeader (:73) claims the organisation id comes from a header. AddressService.create takes organisationId as a parameter and never reads a header, and the test passes the ORG constant straight in. Its id assertion (:90) also checks the value the save stub itself set (:78), so that line cannot fail.
todos.fix: Must: the title states what the assertions prove, the given organisation id and ACTIVE status on the created address, and no assertion checks a value the stub wrote. One way: rename it to create_setsTheGivenOrganisationIdAndActiveStatus and drop the getId assertion, or replace it with an assertion on a field the service sets.
